blocks.orig: Ang’ata Tarangire Camp lies in the heart of Tarangire National Park overlooking the Tarangire River. It offers 8 beautifully designed and spacious tents (one of which is an interconnected family tent), equipped with fluffy beds, a small sitting area, a cosy outside terrace, and a luxury appointed ensuite bathroom. A public lounge tent allows you to relax before a sumptuous dinner in the restaurant, after which the Bush TV (a campfire) awaits to end your night in style. An ideal place to stay in luxury while still living that true camping experience!
blocks.html: Ang’ata Tarangire Camp is set in the centre of Tarangire National Park with a view of the Tarangire River. There are 8 roomy, beautifully designed tents (including one interconnected family tent), each with soft beds, a small seating area, a cosy terrace outside and a luxuriously appointed ensuite bathroom. You can relax in a shared lounge tent before a lavish dinner in the restaurant, and afterwards the Bush TV (a campfire) is waiting to close the evening in style. A perfect choice if you want luxury while still enjoying a genuine camping experience!
